subheader.string: NitroBolt is a mod of TurboWarp with tons of new features, and a haven for developers who don't want to be restricted by "compatibility". Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. NitroBolt is not affiliated with the Scratch Team.

windows-unsigned-warning.string: Direct downloads are not code signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show a warning. Click "More info," verify that the file came from the official NitroBolt GitHub release, then click "Run anyway."

windows-legacy-description.string: These builds support older versions of Windows by using an older version of Electron. They are slower and receive fewer security improvements than the standard builds.

mac-install-help.string: Download the disk image, open it, and drag NitroBolt into Applications. If Finder says NitroBolt already exists, choose "Replace."

mac-unsigned-warning.string: NitroBolt is not currently signed or notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click NitroBolt in Applications, choose "Open," then confirm that you want to open it.
